title: Coupe
driverAssistBrand: Lamborghini Driver Assist (VW Group / Audi-derived ADAS stack)
infotainment: Tri-display setup: 12.3" digital instrument cluster, 8.4" center touchscreen (portrait orientation), 9.1" passenger display. Wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto. Amazon Alexa integration with OTA-updatable functions.
adasStandard: Adaptive cruise control, lane-departure warning, automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, traffic-sign recognition, 360° park-assist cameras with dynamic guidelines — all included as standard with the launch-edition US package. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/revuelto
adasOptional: Highway driving package (lane-keep assist, semi-autonomous lane-centering), advanced parking package. Source: https://www.kbb.com/lamborghini/revuelto/2025/specs/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard. HD rearview camera with dynamic guidelines and multi-angle views integrated into the 8.4-inch center touchscreen. NHTSA Recall 25V477 (mfr report Jan 29 2026) covers a software defect that may prevent the rearview camera image from displaying on certain MY24/MY25 Revueltos — remedy via dealer software update. Source: https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/rcl/2025/RCLRPT-25V477-0658.pdf , https://www.autoblog.com/news/the-lamborghini-revuelto-is-now-on-its-4th-recall
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360° surround-view camera system (four cameras, top-down composite view). No dedicated Honda-LaneWatch-style side-blind camera. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/revuelto
subscriptionFeatures: Lamborghini Connect connected services (remote start/lock, vehicle tracking, OTA updates, security operations center) are subscription-based — typically bundled free for an initial period (length not publicly disclosed), then renewal via dealer at owner's cost. Drive performance, ADAS, and infotainment local features remain functional if the subscription lapses. Track-telemetry camera recording is part of the Connect subscription. No heated-seat-as-subscription style gating found. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/ownership/lamborghini-connect/guide-to-connected-services
drmNotes: The Revuelto operates fully offline — drive functions do not depend on a cellular connection. Lamborghini Connect (telematics, remote start/lock via UNICA app, security tracking, track telemetry, OTA software updates) requires connectivity and an active subscription, but the car drives without it. Lamborghini publishes a Revuelto-specific connected-services privacy policy detailing data collected. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/original/DAM/lamborghini/legal/revuelto/2025/USA_English_Revuelto_disclaimer_website_v1.pdf , https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/ownership/lamborghini-connect
killSwitchNotes: Data unavailable: no public disclosure of an impaired-driving-detection kill switch on the MY25 Revuelto. The vehicle ships well before the IIJA-mandated passive impairment detection (~2027 target). Cabin-monitoring hardware capable of driver-state inference is not advertised as a standard feature.
knownIssues: Build-quality and software issues have plagued early Revueltos: four NHTSA recalls in ~30 months (wiper rod, oil-circuit screws, door gas-spring pins, rearview camera software). California lemon-law cases have been filed. Source: https://californialemonattorneys.com/door-recall-even-a-600k-lamborghini-revuelto-can-be-a-lemon/ , https://www.cars.com/research/lamborghini-revuelto/recalls/
recalls: 1. **24V-749** (Oct 2024): Windshield wiper connecting rod may bend or detach, 455 US units. 2. **24V-911** (Dec 2024): Oil-circuit flange screws may be improperly tightened, oil leak risk. 3. **25V-499** (Jul 2025): Door gas-spring spherical pins improperly torqued, 27 US units (20 MY24 + 7 MY25). 4. **25V-477** (filed Jan 2026): Rearview-camera image may fail to display due to software defect, MY24-MY25. Source: https://www.cars.com/research/lamborghini-revuelto/recalls/
stateIncentives: Generally none — vehicle price exceeds nearly every state PHEV incentive program's MSRP cap (e.g., CA CVRP capped at $60K-$80K depending on year; the Revuelto's $600K+ MSRP excludes it). Owners may benefit from PHEV-specific HOV-lane stickers in some states (CA Clean Air Vehicle decals) where eligibility is powertrain-based not price-based. Source: https://cleanvehiclerebate.org/

title: Alleggerita
infotainment: Tri-display: 12.3" + 8.4" + 9.1". Wireless CarPlay/AA. Alleggerita swaps power seats for lightweight manually-adjustable carbon-shell sports seats.
adasStandard: Adaptive cruise control, lane-departure warning, automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, 360° park-assist cameras, traffic-sign recognition. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/temerario
adasOptional: Highway-driving assistance package (lane-centering), advanced parking. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/lamborghini/temerario/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard. HD rearview camera with dynamic guidelines and multi-angle modes. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/temerario
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360° surround-view (four cameras). Alleggerita adds no camera changes. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/temerario
subscriptionFeatures: Lamborghini Connect connected services — initial bundle then dealer renewal. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/ownership/lamborghini-connect/guide-to-connected-services
drmNotes: Operates fully offline. Lamborghini Connect subscription-based, does not gate drive functions. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/ownership/lamborghini-connect
killSwitchNotes: Data unavailable: no public disclosure of an impaired-driving-detection kill switch.
knownIssues: Alleggerita is the optional ~$75K lightweight package: carbon-fiber bodywork (extended front splitter, side skirts, larger inlets, rear hatch, aggressive rear spoiler), titanium exhaust, carbon-fiber doorcards, manually-adjustable lightweight seats. Together they shave ~55 lb and boost downforce ~67%. No new mechanical failure modes identified vs the base trim; too early in sales cycle for field issues. Source: https://carbuzz.com/2026-lamborghini-temerario-first-drive-review/ , https://www.autoevolution.com/news/lamborghini-finally-kicks-off-temerario-deliveries-lightweight-alleggerita-also-available-263069.html
recalls: No NHTSA recalls as of 2026-05-21. Source: https://www.cars.com/research/lamborghini/recalls/
stateIncentives: Generally none at this MSRP. PHEV HOV-decal eligibility may apply where powertrain-based. Source: https://cleanvehiclerebate.org/

title: SE
driverAssistBrand: Lamborghini Driver Assist (Audi-derived; analogous to Audi Pre Sense / Adaptive Drive Assist — Level 2 hands-on lane-centering with adaptive cruise)
infotainment: Dual portrait touchscreens (8.6" upper for nav/media, 8.6" lower for climate/seat/drive modes), 12.3" digital instrument cluster. Wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto. Alexa built-in with OTA-updated functions. Bang & Olufsen 3D Advanced Sound System optional.
adasStandard: Adaptive cruise control, lane-departure warning, automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert, 360° surround-view camera, traffic-sign recognition, intelligent speed limiter, rear pre-sense, side assist. Inherited from the VW Group / Audi Q8 ADAS stack. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/urus/urus-se , https://www.lamborghinihouston.com/2025-lamborghini-urus-se
adasOptional: Highway-driving assistance with lane-centering, advanced park assist with remote parking, head-up display upgrades. Source: https://www.thedrive.com/car-reviews/2025-lamborghini-urus-se-review
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard HD rearview camera integrated with the dual-touchscreen infotainment stack. Multi-angle (rear / corner / top-down composite) with dynamic guidelines. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/urus/urus-se
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360° surround-view system (four cameras: front, rear, two mirror-mounted). Top-down composite view, curb-side close-up modes, off-road camera modes. No dedicated Honda-LaneWatch-style side-blind camera. Trailer-view assist available with the towing-prep option. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/models/urus/urus-se
subscriptionFeatures: Urus Connect connected services bundle (remote app, security tracking, OTA, Alexa). No subscription gating on heated seats, ADAS, or drive modes. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/ownership/lamborghini-connect/urus-connect
drmNotes: Operates fully offline. Lamborghini Connect (Urus Connect) provides remote start/lock, vehicle tracking, OTA updates, security operations center alerts, and Alexa integration — subscription-based but does not gate drive or comfort features. Trial period typically included, dealer renewal thereafter. Source: https://www.lamborghini.com/en-en/ownership/lamborghini-connect/urus-connect
killSwitchNotes: Data unavailable: no public disclosure of an impaired-driving-detection kill switch. The Urus SE shares the VW Group MLB Evo platform with Q8/Cayenne/Bentayga; any IIJA HALT compliance will likely be implemented platform-wide post-2027.
knownIssues: First model year of the PHEV Urus variant. Owner-forum reports during MY25 highlight occasional 12V-battery drain when the car sits for weeks (common to high-voltage hybrids that wake periodically), and some EV-mode regen feel complaints. The Urus base platform (MLB Evo, shared with Q8/Cayenne/Bentayga) has a mature reliability profile by Lamborghini standards. Source: https://www.thedrive.com/car-reviews/2025-lamborghini-urus-se-review
recalls: No MY25 Urus SE-specific NHTSA recalls posted as of 2026-05-21. Carryover recalls from the non-hybrid Urus platform (Takata airbag follow-ups, etc.) may apply to specific VIN ranges. Source: https://www.cars.com/research/lamborghini/recalls/
stateIncentives: Generally none — MSRP exceeds state PHEV incentive caps (CA CVRP cap is well under $80K). HOV-decal eligibility may apply in CA / other states where eligibility is powertrain-based not MSRP-based, allowing solo HOV access with a Clean Air Vehicle decal. Source: https://cleanvehiclerebate.org/
